description: This file defines a utility class for loading native libraries related to PyTorch's code generation. It includes a method to load the 'torch-code-gen' library and handles potential failures gracefully.

classes.name: PyTorchCodegenLoader
classes.description: A utility class responsible for loading the native 'torch-code-gen' library required by PyTorch for code generation.

methods.name: loadNativeLibs
methods.description: Attempts to load the native 'torch-code-gen' library using NativeLoader, catching any exceptions to ensure graceful handling if loading fails.
